name: 3D Gaussian Splatting MVP
aliases: Adaptive Surface Splatting Using Elliptical Gaussians
definition: A self-contained Jupyter notebook implementation of the core 3D Gaussian Splatting algorithm in pure PyTorch without custom CUDA kernels, intended as a teaching reference.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting MVP is a pure-PyTorch teaching implementation that renders 3D Gaussians via alpha blending, distinguished by its readable Python loop instead of optimized CUDA rasterization.
